name: Threshold — off with six cards in the graveyard (Werebear, Patriarch's Desire)
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Found while checking the "gets an additional" change. "there are seven or more cards in your graveyard" was not read (the graveyard-count condition wanted a word before "cards"), and an unread condition is always true: Werebear was 4/4 with an empty graveyard. With six cards Werebear is 1/1 and the Giant has only Patriarch's Desire's first +2/-2.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
